Fabulous on all fronts, a few days here for my daughter’s wedding. Everything looked after beautifully by Ethem, as close to faultless as possible. There are less expensive hotels, but the level of service justifies the price.

We had a wonderful experience - would highly recommend. Great staff, amazing food, overall one of the best hotels we have ever been to. We would 100% return for another trip - better than any resort in the United States or Europe at a very competitive price.

From the moment we entered our hotel, the parking attendant, the receptionist, everyone is extremely helpful. And they were very, very successful with incredible service The food is really good, but since the prices are the price of the bodrum, you have to meet normally for this style of A+ places.

This is a beautiful property and I would say it’s a great place to stay but I don’t think the value is there. The rooms are poorly designed and the service in the dining areas was hit or miss. Don’t get me wrong, some staff were amazing. But not all. It was a problem to ask multiple times for the same item and it never arrived. The location is stunning. I would recommend if there weren’t other places of better value in the area. It is a place for the locals, and they treated us like that. If you speak Turkish, it will take you far here!

Beautiful boutique hotel with regular sized rooms. Very clean , staff was great , service was great. Food was good. Classy crowd of guests staying at the hotel. Great choices of food offered at the restaurant. The tanning area was great offering free towel service

I stayed at no.81 in May 2025. This was my first time in Bodrum. Great location, very professional, lovely crew. Great breakfast and beach. Türkbükü is one of hot spots in Bodrum. The hotel is right in front of the beach. I enjoyed my 2 nights stay a lot at no.81. Highly recommended.

Upon check in I was escorted to my room which was up 4 flights of stairs and then down another flight of stairs to my room. If walking and carrying your luggage is an issue. Be aware. The gentlemen just opened the door to the room with no explanation of anything. The room was very basic. The shower was quite dirty with mold and didn’t drain. Upon request to clean nothing was corrected. The positives. The sun deck, beds and restaurant were excellent. The staff were fantastic as well. Don’t think I would stay here again for $800 USD a night.

Above expectations, we met as a small group of high school friends and had a blast, four days in a row. Weather was fantastic, crystal clear waters, very nice ambience. Afternoon and happy hour; we did not want it to end. And dinners and nice music was just top of the line, thanks to all who made this so unforgettable.

We stayed here with my fiance in the beginning of June. The hotel is very well located, staff is super friendly and kind, food is flawless and drinks are at top level, beverage selection is superb and offers a wide variety. We will be back sure!

This exquisite boutique hotel in the exclusive seaside French Riviera of Turkey known as Bodrum is utter paradise. The owner Pamir GM Ethem and food/beverage director Berkehan curate flawless hospitality that is blended with perfect Mediterranean cuisine in a serene setting as they become incredible friends on your getaway. Awesome DJ spins great music in the evenings while perfect cocktails are the balms for your soul. The perfect shangri la I am so hooked. Cannot wait till my next visit. This hotel has my heart.

A most gorgeous boutique hotel nestled by the ocean in the the perfect spot of this riviera of Turkey. Impeccable service and a grade AA oceanfront bar and restaurant that serves an authentic Turkish breakfast seals the deal. A top notch in room massage was organized while the charm of this modern contemporary property by all the seaside nightlife made you want to not leave the hotel and enjoy the stunning sea views of the Aegean. General manager Ethem is always a call away for making any wish come true. This property is my new addiction and I cannot wait to return.

October was a time when most places in Türkbükü were closed, and No81 Hotel was perfect with its location, superb sea, food, and staff service. The family atmosphere it created made it feel like home. The Daze Restaurant, located within the hotel, serves a beach menu during the day and elegantly presented chef's plates at night.
